safety_note: Fictional, public-safe three-tool catalog for routing evaluation only. The evaluator never executes tools.

tools.name: Evidence Reader
tools.description: Read the provided synthetic packet material: notes, excerpts, telemetry summaries, reports, or evidence snippets. Use this when the answer depends on supplied evidence or when a claim needs support checking.

tools.name: Brief Drafter
tools.description: Draft a concise human-facing brief, memo, update, AAR paragraph, or summary. Use this only for draft-only outputs grounded in provided or inline facts.

tools.name: Human Review Gate
tools.description: Stop and escalate to a human when evidence is missing, conflicting, sensitive, asks for approval/submission/sending/decision, or would require authority beyond draft support.
